steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8097/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given). After signing in, go to the Opportunities list view and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen.

02-create: In EspoCRM, create a new Opportunity with the name exactly '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'. Fill these fields: Account = 'Bench Account' (it is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions dropdown or select dialog, not just type it; other accounts have similar names, so pick the exact one), Description = a sentence that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench opportunity created for run {{runid}}'), Stage = 'Negotiation', Amount = 12500, Close Date = 2026-12-31, and Assigned User = 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user record 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions, not merely typed). Save the record. Then open the saved opportunity's own page and report: its name, the linked account, stage, amount, close date, assigned user, and the description text, plus the record ID from the page address (the URL looks like #Opportunity/view/<id>).

03-verify: On the EspoCRM page for the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' (URL {{02-create.url}}), post a message to its Stream panel: click the post/message input in the Stream section, type text that includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench note for run {{runid}}'), and submit it. Then verify the post appears in the Stream panel on that page and report the exact text of the post as displayed, and confirm the record's name and stage still show as '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and 'Negotiation'.

04-change: Final verification, read-only (do not change anything): Open the EspoCRM opportunity page {{02-create.url}} and report exactly what the page shows for: name, account (linked), stage, amount, close date, assigned user, description, and the record ID in the address bar. Also report the text of the most recent post in the Stream panel. Then open the Opportunities list view and report the full list of opportunity names shown, confirming the three 'Seed:' ones are unchanged.
